name: ReclaimHostBanner

component.name: ReclaimHostBanner
component.description: Prompts the original host to reclaim the host role from the current host. Remains visible until dismissed or the participant is no longer eligible.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the banner.

props.name: withOwnViewport
props.description: Renders the area the banner appears in. Keep the default. With false, the banner appears only if another ReclaimHostBanner is mounted in the same ZoomUIToolkitProvider.

behavior: ZoomUIToolkitProvider already shows this banner. To render your own, set sessionOptions.session.disableReclaimHostBanner to true so it doesn't appear twice.
Shown to the original host (the participant whose token has role_type 1) whenever another participant is host, whether or not they are still a co-host.

Shows "<host name> is currently host. Reclaiming host may disrupt current session experience." with "Reclaim host" and "Stay participant" buttons. Co-hosts see "Stay manager" instead of "Stay participant". Either button dismisses the banner.
The banner is hidden while the participant is already host or is in a breakout room. It does not dismiss automatically.
Once dismissed, it stays hidden until the participant becomes host again and then loses the role.
